facts: ConversationSegmentStore persists request input fingerprints and provider thread/account identity, but not a replayable Responses result.
On an exact retry after process restart, input_prefix_length equals the full current input length.
responses_incremental_body slices an empty delta and returns None.
The Responses path requires both an anchor and a non-None incremental prompt to continue the existing Notion thread; otherwise it invokes initial_completion on a fresh full prompt.

Therefore an already-processed tool-result request retried after restart is not replayed and does not continue the recorded provider thread; it is re-planned from the full transcript on a new provider completion.
risk: The full transcript tells the model not to repeat completed actions, but this is prompt-level guidance rather than an idempotency guarantee. NOTION_CORE_DONE restart/recovery cannot be claimed until exact-request replay is fail-closed or durably replayable without re-planning an already-processed tool result.
non_goals: No hosted CI or live Notion traffic was started.
No native Windows claim is made.
candidate_direction: Add a durable request-replay boundary keyed by conversation/turn plus exact request fingerprint. Preferred acceptance behavior is to replay the prior Responses result (including call id/output shape) without provider inference. If durable replay data cannot be safely stored, exact replay must fail closed rather than silently starting a new provider plan.
